title: Oxidation and coupling of β-diketiminate ligand in lanthanide complexes: Novel eight-nuclear lanthanide clusters with μ-, μ3-Cl, and μ4-O bridges

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear lanthanide oxide/chloride cluster with bridging oxidized β-diketiminate L4

synthesis.procedure: [CH{(Me)C=NC6H3-2,6-iPr}2]ErCl2(THF)2 (1) (1.05 g, 1.31 mmol) was dissolved in THF (15 mL) in an 80 mL Schlenk flask under nitrogen. Trace dried O2 was then introduced periodically at room temperature over one week by connecting the flask to a 200 mL Schlenk flask charged with 40 mL of CaO-dried O2 and opening the stopcocks for diffusion about 5–6 times per workday for about 30 min each time. The solution changed from pink to orange, was concentrated under reduced pressure to about 5 mL, and pink crystals of 3 were obtained by vapor diffusion of n-hexane into the THF solution. The mother liquor was evaporated and the residue extracted with n-hexane to give the organic coupling product 5.

reagents.name: dioxygen
reagents.amount: 40 mL dried O2 reservoir, diffused periodically

synthesis.time: one week, with periodic O2 diffusion
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 80 mL Schlenk flask under nitrogen with controlled diffusion of dried O2; vapor diffusion of n-hexane into THF
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Concentrated to about 5 mL under reduced pressure; pink crystals by n-hexane vapor diffusion into THF. Mother liquor evaporated and extracted with n-hexane to isolate organic product 5.

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear lanthanide oxide/chloride cluster with bridging oxidized β-diketiminate L4

synthesis.procedure: Using the same controlled-oxidation procedure as for 3, [CH{(Me)C=NC6H3-2,6-iPr}2]DyCl2(THF)2 (2) (0.779 g, 0.98 mmol) in THF was treated at room temperature under nitrogen with periodically introduced trace O2 over several days. Pale yellow crystals of 4 and colorless crystals of organic product 5 were obtained.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Same workup as 3; pale yellow crystals of 4 and colorless crystals of 5.
